fix(codeon): load revision commit preparations through dispatch lineage (#209)

* fix(config): accept runtime executable symlinks

* fix(postgres): cancel undispatched attempts

Durable cancellation can close selected, preparing, or prepared Attempts before an Agent runtime exists. Align the database terminal-state constraint with that domain authority when a runtime closure receipt proves the never-dispatched outcome.

* fix(runtime): restore Cursor and Grok startup

Accept current provider ACP contracts without fabricating account identity, and keep daemon startup probes separate from repository ambient inspection.

* fix(runtime): harden provider startup probes

Keep Cursor ambient validation mandatory through an isolated startup worktree, and reject ambiguous Grok authentication catalogs.

* fix(merge): reconcile external PR merges

Preserve strict metadata validation for Codeon mutations while allowing exact reviewed PRs merged externally to finalize through provider and Git readback.

* fix(runtime): recover dispatches after restart

* fix(runtime): recover transient agent failures

Normalize provider digest representations and keep operation-scoped errors from permanently disabling runtime profiles. Skip v2 activity writes for legacy Cursor operations.

* fix(codeon): classify legacy activity leases and bind dispatch evidence

Codex activity callbacks were mapped to PersistenceUnavailable whenever a
v1 dispatch had NULL lease columns, flooding logs and hiding SQLSTATE.
Classify that as PolicyUnavailable/IgnoredLegacyPolicy, keep real sqlx
details, and land the already-verified capacity owner accounting plus
same-Operation cross-dispatch coverage and current-dispatch publication
observation filters.

* fix(codeon): load revision commit preparations through dispatch lineage

Revision coverage still used the current-dispatch-only gate loader, so a
retry Dispatch could miss preparations recorded earlier in the same
Operation. Drive both public coverage loaders through isolated Postgres
after creating two Dispatches via real store APIs.
